subject: Geography
description: Major + minor ports: location, importance, special features

questions.stem: India's BUSIEST port (most cargo handled) is:
questions.explanation: MUNDRA PORT (Gujarat, Adani-operated) — India's BIGGEST port by cargo volume since 2013-14 (overtook Kandla). Largest PRIVATE port. Located in Kutch district. JNPT (Jawaharlal Nehru Port Trust, Mumbai) — largest CONTAINER port. KANDLA / DEENDAYAL — major govt port (Gujarat). Other major ports: Mumbai, Mormugao (Goa), Cochin (Kerala), Tuticorin (TN — recently V.O. Chidambaranar), Chennai, Visakhapatnam, Paradip (Odisha), Kolkata, Haldia, Ennore (now Kamarajar), New Mangalore. India has 12 MAJOR PORTS (under central govt) + 200+ minor / non-major ports (under state govts).
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: MUMBAI PORT (Bombay) is on the COAST of which sea?
questions.explanation: Mumbai (formerly BOMBAY) — on west coast of India, ARABIAN SEA. Natural deep-water harbour — one of the world's best. Originally 7 islands, joined into peninsula by reclamation. Major economic + financial hub. JNPT (Nhava Sheva, opened 1989) on the mainland nearby — handles ~50% of India's container traffic. WEST COAST major ports: Kandla, Mundra, Mumbai, JNPT, Mormugao (Goa), New Mangalore, Cochin. EAST COAST: Tuticorin, Chennai, Ennore, Visakhapatnam, Paradip, Kolkata, Haldia.

questions.stem: VISAKHAPATNAM (VIZAG) PORT is in which state?
questions.explanation: VISAKHAPATNAM (VIZAG) — Andhra Pradesh, east coast (Bay of Bengal). India's DEEPEST port (natural deep-water harbour). Major naval base — HQ of EASTERN NAVAL COMMAND of Indian Navy. Important for: iron-ore exports, shipbuilding (Hindustan Shipyard Ltd), petroleum refining (HPCL Vizag refinery). Vizag Steel Plant nearby. Submarine + aircraft-carrier dockyard. After AP-Telangana split (2014), Vizag is one of AP's largest cities (along with Vijayawada). 'CITY OF DESTINY'.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: KANDLA PORT (recently RENAMED Deendayal Port) is in which state?
questions.explanation: KANDLA PORT — Gulf of Kutch, GUJARAT. Renamed DEENDAYAL PORT in 2017 (after Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya). Built post-1947 to replace Karachi (which became Pakistan's). One of India's busiest ports. Tax-free SEZ nearby. Salt manufacture in Kutch nearby (Sambhar — Rajasthan, Kandla — Gujarat are top salt producers). Distractor: maximum confusion is with MUMBAI (also west coast) but Mumbai is in Maharashtra, much further south.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: PARADIP PORT in eastern India is in which state?
questions.explanation: PARADIP PORT — ODISHA, on Mahanadi delta (Bay of Bengal). India's deepest natural port handling iron ore + coal exports. State of Odisha + nearby Jharkhand are rich in iron, coal, manganese; Paradip is the export gateway. Indian Oil Corp's Paradip Refinery nearby. Other Odisha port: Dhamra (private, Adani-run). KOLKATA + HALDIA — twin ports of Hooghly River, West Bengal. ENNORE — north of Chennai (now Kamarajar Port).

questions.stem: Cochin / KOCHI PORT is on the:
questions.explanation: COCHIN / KOCHI — KERALA, on Arabian Sea. Natural harbour at confluence of backwaters + sea (Vembanad Lake area). One of India's busiest ports. Naval base — HQ of SOUTHERN NAVAL COMMAND. Vallarpadam International Container Trans-shipment Terminal — major Asian trans-shipment hub. India's first TRANS-SHIPMENT port. Vizhinjam Port (also Kerala — Adani) — newer deep-water trans-shipment port; opening 2024-25.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.stem: JNPT (JAWAHARLAL NEHRU PORT TRUST), India's largest CONTAINER port, is at:
questions.explanation: JNPT — at NHAVA SHEVA, Raigad district (Navi Mumbai mainland), Maharashtra. Built to relieve Mumbai Port (older, increasingly congested). Operating since 1989. India's largest CONTAINER port — handles ~50% of country's container traffic. Renamed 'JAWAHARLAL NEHRU PORT AUTHORITY' (JNPA) in 2022 (Major Port Authorities Act 2021). Connected by road + rail + dedicated freight corridor. Modernised continuously. Distractor 1 — Mumbai PORT is separate (older, smaller now).
